trajectory.command: ls ideas/ changes/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git status --short
grep -rn "x" --include="*.md" . | grep -v "\.git/" | head -50; echo "---registry---"; cat caped.registry

grep -rn "depends_on: x\|spawned_from: x\|Idea: x\|Change: x\|Archives: x" --include="*.md" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.git/"; echo "---git log trailers---"; git log --format='%(trailers)' | grep -i "x" | head; echo "---all files---"; git ls-files
git mv ideas/x.md ideas/pre-push-hooks.md && sed -i 's/^name: x$/name: pre-push-hooks/' ideas/pre-push-hooks.md && git diff --cached --stat && echo "---" && git diff --cached
sed -i '' 's/^name: x$/name: pre-push-hooks/' ideas/pre-push-hooks.md && git diff --cached --stat && echo "---" && git diff --cached
head -3 ideas/pre-push-hooks.md; echo "---"; git diff --cached -M --stat; git status --short
git commit -m "Rename idea x to pre-push-hooks" && git log --oneline -1 && git status --short
ls ideas/; echo "---"; head -3 ideas/pre-push-hooks.md; echo "---"; scripts/caped.sh check
